snippet.title: Cardtographer Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Cardtographer is the upcoming Deckbuilder with Roguelike and Roguelite Elements from Tistic Games.
You can select up to 4 heroes, alone or in offline/online Coop.

Each of your 4 heroes brings unique cards and abilities — combine their strengths to overcome their weaknesses.
Select your Dream Team to combine their abilities.
Collect more and more cards and build powerful decks to lead one or more champions to victory!

Adapt to each playthrough, as randomly generated maps and events force you to make tough decisions.
Earn gold, items, and new cards in exciting battles and encounters.

Find new allies, make sacrifices at ancient sites,  raid camps for resources or help the desperate inhabitants of the world - the choice is yours!

Be careful as you push deeper into a dangerous world, not everything is as it seems at first glance.
Your success depends on combining cards in the best possible way and reacting to an ever-changing world.

Reflect your tactical decisions all the time!

Choose from 4 unique champion classes, each with their own deck, combat type and multiple play styles.

Unlock and master over 230 Cards across multiple champion skills.

Kill Bosses to reach the highest Card Upgrades!

Play with 1, 2, 3 or 4 champions and combine their strengths to cover their weaknesses.

Many map events with meaningful choices and consequences.

Procedurally generated world maps deliver always new adventures.

WISHLIST now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3460540/Cardtographer/
